gotchas.text: LM Studio caps concurrent predictions at 4 by default; anything above measures its internal queue, not the engine. Reload with 'lms load <model> --parallel N' before concurrency sweeps — the parallel value is part of the config fingerprint.

LM Studio's model.yaml for google/gemma-4-e2b sets enableThinking=true by default (the HF chat template defaults enable_thinking=false) — with eval workloads capped at 256 output tokens the thought block can consume the whole budget and the final answer is truncated away.
